preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 8 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 8 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 8 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case contains three integers R, C, K where 1 ≤ R, C, K ≤ 8.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 1 + sum(1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: The first line is T (number of test cases), followed by exactly T lines of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == len(stdin.splitlines()) - 1 for _ in range(1)) and all(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit() for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout contains exactly one integer per line, representing the count of reachable squares.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == len({(r, c) for r in range(1, 9) for c in range(1, 9) if any((abs(r - R) ** 2 + abs(c - C) ** 2 <= 2 * k ** 2) for k in range(0, K + 1))}) for i, (R, C, K) in enumerate([tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) if line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case (R, C, K), the output is the number of distinct squares (r, c) reachable by the king in at most K moves, where reachability is defined by the king's movement rule: (r'-r)² + (c'-c)² ≤ 2 * k² for some k in 0..K.
